name: Cocoa pod, whole (fresh, as harvested)
source: Whole fresh Theobroma cacao pod (husk + wet bean + pulp): illustrative high-moisture fibrous-fruit proximate (per kg) water 750 g, protein 20 g, fat 15 g, carbohydrate/fibre 175 g, ash 40 g.
notes: Standard protein/fat/carbohydrate/water elemental conversion factors (see wheat-grain.json). The pod is opened into a wet-bean-plus-pulp fraction and a husk fraction by a fixed real mass ratio (origin/cocoa.ts), not by this file's own profile, since bean and husk are compositionally very different fractions of the same pod. Ash is split toward potassium, reflecting cocoa's well-documented high potash content.
